Manipulation and Recruitment

When it comes to professional-grade astroturfing and disruption/manipulation of discussions/groups, etc, subversive users and shady organizations seldom pull this feat off entirely as lone entities – that is, without the assistance of not only those on their team and aware of the ploy, but also those (mostly) genuine people who get reeled into contributing to the subversion in some way or another (dupes, if you will). There are many tactics involved with recruitment and utilization of dupes, we will only cover a little bit of it here though.

 

Meatpuppetry

As mentioned in the Terms, Meatpuppetry involves the bending of genuine people to the will of the subversive user/organization/agenda. This practice is heavily associated with astroturfing in general and can be partially conceptualized by looking at the wiki entry for Sockpuppet (Internet), under 2.4: Meatpuppet (however that particular snippet more refers to a sockpuppet as opposed to this definition) and the wikipedia.org Sock puppetry Conduct policy page, under 4: Meatpuppetry and by understanding the concept of grooming/enticing others to being meatpuppets without them fully realizing they're being played.

From the second-linked entry above:

This section in a nutshell: Do not recruit your friends, family members, or communities of people who agree with you for the purpose of coming to Wikipedia and supporting your side of a debate.

From that, the basic inference can be made here that Meatpuppetry involves the recruitment of others to fraudulently or without question, with or without prior knowledge, aid a deceitful/manipulative/subversive/malicious agenda.

 

One could say that Crowd Renting is tantamount or related to Meatpuppetry, and that would at least be partially correct. But in the case of Crowd Renting, the participants – especially if paid – generally know they're participating in fraud and thus consenting; for the purpose of this document, we're dealing mostly with non-consenting meat puppets 'recruited' by malevolent influences, though a consideration should be made for the recruitment of outsiders who are aware enough of and willing to participate in a malicious online/guerrilla operation and are also considerable as consenting meat puppets.

In the scenario mostly at hand, online Meatpuppetry, most Meatpuppets are unaware that they are being manipulated into their beliefs/actions by a dishonest influence. This is the entire point of using Sockpuppets with/and/or other tactics to obfuscate the fraudulent/malicious agenda/origin; the Meatpuppet doesn't know and so their behavior seems genuine and theoretically is not tied back to the person/people pulling the strings.

User Grooming

Grooming users is a fundamental requirement of recruiting Meatpuppets. One way or another, whether a willing and in-the-know-enough participant or a manipulated dupe, the Meatpuppet is convinced to believe and/or do things which they might be reluctant to or skeptical of at first. Depending on the intended use(s) of the Meatpuppet and many other factors, several tactics will be employed to bypass the target's discernment and lull them into a false sense of security. Successful grooming presents opportunities which include, but are not limited to:

  • Obtaining information about the target, and/or their supporters and/or connected contacts, and their activities/personalities/etc.
  • Disseminating subtle disinformation to the target(s).
  • Convincing the target(s) that another target user or group is suspicious and that they should rally against them.
  • Befriending the target(s) so that they will offer support if ever heat is applied to a Sockpuppet account (or even the personal account of a Sockpuppet string puller).
  • Turning the target(s) into propaganda mouthpieces (see also: disinfo).
  • Feeding the target(s) a Witch Hunt/Goose Chase against another user (a sockpuppet account or genuine user), to A: see if the target(s) is/are inclined to investigate such things, or B: see if the target(s) are trusting or potentially investigating anyone already.
  • Utilizing the target(s) as a double-agent.
  • Playing 'both sides' of an argument/cause/discussion/etc against one another, while seeding disinformation in to deceive and manipulate everyone.

Once a user is under the spell of successful grooming, their uses as a Meatpuppet are many and often times it is difficult to break the hold over them even after the subversive influence has been exposed. Sometimes a Meatpuppet network will take on a proverbial life of its own which endures long after the originators are exposed and shut down or just plain walk away after they're no longer needed.

Grooming is also a concept known outside of the online or forum disruption realms. There's no need to get into all of it here, but it is sufficient to say that grooming is manipulating someone in such a way that they essentially walk right into your manipulation with little resistance.

User Brigading

User Brigading is when a genuine website user is targeted by a subversive website user/group with a campaign of vote manipulation (generally downvotes for the target or any support they get, and upvotes for opposition to the target) designed to isolate the target and silence them and/or run them off the website – or to otherwise prevent interference by the target and/or their supporters with an agenda/goal/objective pursued by the subversive user(s).

It could very much be argued that User Brigading, especially when augmented by Sockpuppets & Meatpuppets with/and/or coordinated harassment/smearing/threats/etc, is a form of or falls under the category of Gang Stalking. As this implies, brigading isn't necessarily solely about upvoting or downvoting; often the goal of discrediting/isolating the target requires disinformation and/or harrassment campaigns to be trickled out via Sockpuppets & Meatpuppets, or could require further grooming of new/existing Meatpuppets.

Brigading, of course, doesn't always have to be mass-down/up voting; the Trickle Voting method can also be employed to stalk a target and isolate/censor/silence ward off them and their support through that and the other various Gang Stalking tactics.

There's not much else to add here, but by now you can see how easy and effective Gang Stalking/User Brigading can be if a subversive user or group is left undetected.
